title: Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture (Marton)
statement: A subset A of F_2^n with |A+A| <= K|A| is covered by at most 2K^12 cosets of a subgroup of size at most |A|.
how_it_was_proved: Gowers, Green, Manners and Tao (2023) by an entropy argument; formalized in Lean 4 within three weeks by a collaborative project.

sources.cite: W. T. Gowers, B. Green, F. Manners and T. Tao, On a conjecture of Marton, Ann. of Math. 201 (2025) 515-549

steps.statement: Entropic Ruzsa distance and its decrement
Iterating the decrement until the distance vanishes
